Based on the retrieved excerpts, **clause 8.1.3** directly addresses your question.

This clause requires the organization to **establish processes for implementing and controlling planned temporary and permanent changes that impact OH&S performance**, including changes to work conditions and equipment. It also requires reviewing unintended consequences of changes and acting to mitigate any adverse effects.

Rearranging the production line layout constitutes a **change to work conditions and equipment** that could affect OH&S performance, so clause 8.1.3 applies.

Additionally, **clause 8.1.1** supports this by requiring the organization to **plan, implement, control and maintain the processes needed to meet OH&S system requirements**, including establishing operating criteria and controlling processes to those criteria.
